notes: Ran all five reviewers sequentially in one context, so independence between R1 and the DA on the D = infinity finding is only role-based (R1 flagged it MAJOR, the DA escalated it); the skill says the Methodology Reviewer shares its protocol-sweep quotes with the DA, which makes this overlap expected. The skill orders aggregation (BEFORE) before the EIC, but the EIC weights live in the same scores file, so I fixed the weights in scores.json only after writing the EIC reasoning in review.md; the sequence was therefore partly simultaneous. The literature search script refuses queries containing most of the title, so natural queries like 'constrained mean-field Langevin' had to be rephrased, and hyphenated terms such as log-Sobolev count as two words against the 4-word limit; the Bash tool also rejects pipes and heredocs, so kept results had to be read from kept_results.jsonl. 'before_composite' appears in before.json as the official composite (55.5) while the EIC-weighted composite differs (55.2 before weights); I reported 55.5 per the field name. The 'theoretical' paper type gives low weight (0.10) to Experimental Validation, yet reviewers' 0-100 experimental scores in a theory paper still pull the composite; the skill has no guidance on scoring toy experiments in theory papers. Error-audit rules say low-confidence items go to Questions, but extraction-garbled display equations make some proof-level checks (Gronwall constant, lambda in (18), exact M) unverifiable, which left me unsure whether DA-C1 should rest on partly garbled formulas; I rested it on the legible definition of D and Lemma 2.1(i). CRITICAL criteria do not clearly cover 'theorem holds but is vacuous'; I used criterion 1.
